newsitem.title: USA: Payless Shoe August same-store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Payless Shoe August same-store sales rise.

text.p: Payless ShoeSource Inc said Thursday its same store sales in August rose 2.8 percent from the comparable period last year.
Total sales for August fell 0.1 percent to $196.0 million from $196.1 million in August 1995, the retailer said.
During the month, Payless opened 10 new stores and closed 23 stores as part of a previously-announced plan to close underperforming units.
At the end of August, Payless operated 4,267 stores compared with 4,588 last year.
Same store sales for the first seven months of fiscal 1996 rose 4.8 percent from a year ago. Total sales were up three percent to $1.43 billion from $1.39 billion last year.

Sales comparisons for the month of August and seven months were affected by a one-week shift in reporting periods, Payless said. Same store sales declined 1.6 percent for the four weeks ended August 31 and same store sales rose 3.2 percent for the seven months to August 31, when adjusted for the change in reporting periods.
